Profile preview and legacy pending ACCEPT both block clearing active restrictions with absent/empty limit values.

findings.issue: Missing or unreadable dependency produces UNRESOLVED / REVIEW_REQUIRED but portrait only treats MARK_STALE as stale; an earlier SUPPORTED hypothesis remains SUPPORTED and renders 获得支持.
findings.fix: Propagate unknown dependency state to explicit 待重审 presentation and candidate exclusion, without falsely calling an unverified missing source a confirmed withdrawal.
findings.test: Persist a supported linked hypothesis, make its dependency missing/unreadable, reload and require review-required status with no current-support label.

findings.issue: Failed VOID audit followed by RESTORE before successful retry can resurrect the old explanation. Current restored evidence again equals its dependency; retry evaluates old VOID against latest restored rows, sees no VOIDED record, skips it and acknowledges completion.
findings.fix: Derive read-time closure from persisted visible VOID history and replay the individual correction at its committed state. Ensure later RESTORE restores facts without reactivating old withdrawn explanations.
findings.test: Fail claim revision writes for VOID, then RESTORE, restart and retry; require old claim to remain withdrawn and retry not to acknowledge a skipped necessary audit.

findings.issue: Read-time dependency comparison uses raw adapter evidence instead of the audited active/quarantined projection. A second conflicting running completion can share the original recordId while the original evidence still exactly matches; evidence.find keeps that original even though the V4 projection quarantines the duplicate identity.
findings.fix: Validate dependency availability against the existing audited active/quarantined projection; conflicting evidence must become review-required rather than appear fresh.
findings.test: Save a claim on a running slot, add a conflicting duplicate completion for that same slot, then verify the unchanged original bytes do not keep the claim current.

findings.issue: If initial capture throws, sources:null is durable but retry only increments pending forever, even after storage recovers; there is no reconstruction branch.
findings.fix: Reconstruct the prior source view from persisted history at the correction boundary where possible, otherwise expose an explicit unrecoverable review state instead of implying a retryable queue.
findings.test: Inject transient capture failure, restore source readability, restart and verify deterministic reconstruction or explicit unresolved recovery state.
